title: operad review grading
description: The grading in <repository>/.operad/review.json: what critical, major and minor mean, extra rules, and the lowest level that fails a review. A flow's entry falls back field by field to "default".

levels.description: What each severity means, given to the reviewer verbatim.

rules.description: Rules for grading, given to the reviewer verbatim.

fixLevel.description: The lowest severity that fails a review. Wins over dev.json's reviewer.fixLevel.
